replies.body:
Awesome! I would limit the number of diamonds per pile of resources to two blocks, though. it looks like there are about 9 per section on just the top layer, and since the map is pretty small that's a bit too many :)
Good luck with this map, it has potential!

replies.body:
It's great and as many suggested, I feel like the diamond blocks on the map are too plentiful. 
Looking at the surface, there's 27 diamond blocks which makes 9 full decked diamond armoured members. 

Maybe a bit less?
